papers.title: When Shared Estimates Hurt: A Correlation-Scale Phase Boundary in Multi-Agent Collection
papers.current_stage: SPS-C04 outcome-blind literature, T=1.34 endpoint, and nonlinear-row design gates passed; preregistration design next
papers.hypothesis: All-to-all three-scalar averaging has one ordered crossover from harming to helping unique team capture as the field correlation length increases relative to nominal collector spacing.
papers.kill_criterion: Stop before seeds if the analytic crossover, declared-covariance field, or deterministic mechanism tests fail; stop after a bounded fresh diagnostic if no ordered negative-to-positive yield crossing is supported or a non-multi-agent confound explains it.
papers.open_blocker: Before any scientific run: freeze the eta grid, minimum relevant effect, simultaneous inference, fresh seed block, stopping rule, and CPU cap. The conditional novelty confidence is 0.65; no scientific seed or MARL run is authorized.

primary_question: On a prospectively frozen grid, for four collectors with canonical square initialization and identical three-scalar encoders and action decoders, where—if anywhere—does all-to-all averaging change from decreasing to increasing fixed-horizon unique team captures relative to self-only use of each collector's message?
exploratory_result: SPS-WO-05 established action headroom and SPS-WO-06 passed timestep stability. SPS-WO-07 then produced a valid negative bounded-sharing diagnostic: shared-minus-independent effects [3,6,4,-3,0,0,5,-1], mean 1.75, 4/8 positive, descriptive interval [-0.375,3.75]. The frozen mean>=2 and positive>=5/8 components failed, although correctness, matched streams, shared-minus-stationary mean 1.875, and signal difference-in-differences mean 2.125 passed. The joint gate failed and SPS-C03 was closed without confirmation.

SPS-WO-06-TIMESTEP-CONVERGENCE.purpose: Validate that dt=0.02 is a converged discretization; seeds 3001-3008 permanently ineligible for confirmation
SPS-WO-06-TIMESTEP-CONVERGENCE.gate: absolute mean oracle-minus-stationary difference between dt=0.02 and dt=0.01 strictly below 1 particle, with at most 1/8 seed-level sign changes; dt=0.005 mandatory informational

SPS-POWER-ANALYSIS-COORDINATION.purpose: Ex-ante sensitivity analysis for 80% power at a frozen 2.0-particle minimum relevant effect; it cannot consume diagnostic outcomes

SPS-WO-07-ATTRIBUTION-CONTROLS.purpose: Test bounded shared-summary versus local-summary headroom with stationary and alpha=0 controls; seeds 4001-4008 permanently ineligible for confirmation
SPS-WO-07-ATTRIBUTION-CONTROLS.gate: all six explicitly frozen components pass: correctness, matched streams, mean shared-minus-independent at least 2 particles, at least 5/8 positive seeds, mean shared-minus-stationary above zero, and mean alpha-adjusted shared-independent difference-in-differences above zero; descriptive only

engineering_tests.scope: Full available pytest suite after SPS-WO-11. fresh_review.strongest_new_threat: The central bounded-sharing diagnostic failed, no learned or strategic multi-agent method is evaluated, and the negative eight-seed result is not precise enough to become a decisive archival contribution.
